description: Whether a simulated failure of a step in a transaction may have changed anything, when nobody said. tests/unit/test_transaction_corpus.py checks each case against the host's rule (scripted_effect); Studio's default follows the same cases.

cases.name: a code the action declares definite
a code the action doesn't declare
an action with no definite codes
a definite code with an unknown outcome
cases.why: The platform's failure_effect counts a definite code whatever the outcome, so it would derive none. Studio always writes the effect it shows, and the host refuses none with an unknown outcome.

cases.name: another code with an unknown outcome
a called workflow that never started
